_comment: player_death_flavor.json - random flavor line shown right after the 'You have been defeated by X!' message when the player dies. Edit or add to this list freely - player3d.gd picks one at random via NPCFlavorText.get_line('death') at the moment of true death (after the bleed-out window completes).
death: The world grows distant and cold.
Your legs give out beneath you.
A heavy stillness settles over you.
The light dims, and then is gone.
Your thoughts scatter into the void.
A cold hush settles over your mind.
Growing shadows swallow the last of your awareness.
Your senses unravel one by one.
The ground drifts away beneath you.
A distant echo is the last thing you hear.
Stillness claims what remains of you.
